reviews.summary: The live build.json carries machine_check with days_checked 8 and empty lists. llms.txt and feed.xml list the latest day and the required endpoints, and every other check is still empty.

The new try-line sits between the h1 and the first h2 on / and /day/2026-11-09/, linking /try/ and /go/github/ with no tracking parameters. build.json has nav_check (10 pages, none missing), all other checks are empty, and both link targets return 200.

The 2026-11-08 day page has the new 'What did not go to plan' section ahead of the other blocks. It lists the one failed review (T-0077), and its count matches index.json. The 2026-11-09 page shows the required empty-day sentence, and all build.json checks are empty.
The day pages now have a single 'What did not go to plan' block with a definition sentence, and the old block is gone. The index.json items match the block, and all six build.json checks are empty.

The live site meets every acceptance criterion I could observe. build.json has seo_check with 26 pages checked and all lists empty, canonicals are self-referencing, and the sitemap has lastmod for every URL. /about/ now links /brand/, and day pages link to the previous and next days.

Live pages carry unique, data-based descriptions (day, home, product, try), og:description equals them, and build.json shows both new seo_check lists empty with all other checks clean. The day numbers match the day index.json totals.

analyst_md:
**Итог пилота 04–10.11 (10.11 — неполный день, срез 18:02 UTC).** Базы нет: сайт новый, числа ниже — измерения, не прогноз.

| Метрика | 04–10.11 | Цель |
|---|---|---|
| G1 engaged (сумма по дням: 2+2+1+3+10+9+3) | 30 | ≥50 |
| G2 возвраты (08.11: 1, 07.11: 1) | 2 | ≥5 |
| G3 human-источники на /try/ и /go/github/ | 3 и 1 (запросов людей в данных нет) | ≥10 |
| G4 отклик | нет данных в metrics.json | ≥1 |
| G5 агенты/ИИ-краулеры | есть: llms.txt (агент, 10.11), ClaudeBot (04–07.11) | ≥1 |

- Уровни не складываем: краулеры (83–177 запросов в день) — это обнаружение, а не люди.
- Пост в X 10.11 в 13:10 UTC: у ?src=x за день 9 запросов, 2 человека, 1 engaged, referer t.co — 1. Почасовых данных нет, сравнить «до/после» нельзя.
- Остальные каналы: bluesky 2 запроса / 0 людей, threads 2 / 0 (за 04–10.11 по ним в основном превью-боты).
- 4xx упали с 382 (09.11) до 81, сканеров 0. Это неполный день, причину назвать нельзя.
- Google: 1 из 19 URL в индексе, 10 показов, 0 кликов.

G1–G3 вряд ли будут достигнуты. G5 выполнена.
